The `source` arrays reference the official GitHub release URLs of the upstream project, which is consistent with expected packaging practices. There are no command substitutions, function calls, loops, or external downloads in the global scope. No data exfiltration, code execution, or suspicious operations occur during sourcing.

Therefore, running `makepkg --printsrcinfo` on this PKGBUILD is safe, as it cannot trigger execution of the binary or any remote payloads at parse time.
